subject: CS476
filterSummary: Successfully selected 9 out of 10 possible videos. The English selections provide strong, conceptually-driven explanations from reputable sources like Martin Kleppmann and Jakob Jenkov. The Arabic selections are also highly relevant, with excellent coverage for P2P, Consensus, and REST. Coverage for 'Coordination and Publish/Subscribe' in Arabic was not possible as all candidates failed hard gates (duration or relevance).

coverage.note: No candidate reached 3000 views; selected the highest-viewed eligible candidate above 500 views.
One relevant candidate failed the duration gate (>3600s); all other candidates were irrelevant to the topic.

videos.title: Distributed Consensus and Data Replication strategies on the server
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video from a popular system design channel clearly explains the core concepts of distributed consensus and data replication, which are fundamental to the topic.

videos.title: Distributed Systems 1.3: RPC (Remote Procedure Call)
videos.filter_reason: This lecture by a leading expert, Martin Kleppmann, explains Remote Procedure Calls (RPC), a fundamental concept that middleware wrappers abstract, directly addressing the student difficulty of understanding how network communication is hidden.

videos.title: Peer-to-peer (P2P) Networks - Basic Algorithms
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video provides a comprehensive explanation of the basic algorithms behind structured P2P networks, including Chord and Kademlia, which is core to the topic.

videos.title: The Broker Design Pattern
videos.filter_reason: This video clearly explains the Broker design pattern, which is a fundamental architectural concept for implementing publish/subscribe systems in distributed environments.

videos.title: 12- Laravel Project -  API Building &  RESTful API
videos.filter_reason: Among the available English candidates, this project-based tutorial provides a practical guide to building a RESTful API, which can help students understand the concepts through implementation.

videos.title: 10. Blockchain Consensus Algorithms - شرح خوارزميات الإجماع
videos.filter_reason: This video provides a direct and clear explanation of blockchain consensus algorithms in Arabic, including PoW, PoS, and the Byzantine Generals Problem, making it highly relevant.

videos.title: 3.01 شرح مفاهيم البرمجيات | DOS | NOS | Middleware
videos.filter_reason: As the highest-viewed eligible Arabic video on this topic, it provides a solid conceptual explanation of middleware within the context of distributed operating systems.

videos.title: شبكات الحاسوب 11
videos.filter_reason: This comprehensive lecture not only explains P2P architectures but also delves into Distributed Hash Tables (DHTs), directly addressing the core complexity of the topic for students.

videos.title: شرح مفاهيم RESTful - تعلم كيف تبني واجهات REST برمجية API
videos.filter_reason: This video from a well-regarded educational channel provides a clear and concise explanation of the core concepts of RESTful architectures, making it ideal for university students.
